# S.S AI LABS

> S.S AI LABS is a technology and digital growth company that builds websites,
> custom business software, mobile apps, restaurant POS systems, AI automation
> and chatbots, and runs digital marketing and paid advertising for businesses
> in India.

- Website: https://ssailabs.in/
- Experience: 2+ years delivering client projects
- Projects delivered: 95+
- Service area: India (remote delivery worldwide)
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 79869 44752 · Instagram @s.s_ai_labs
- Founders: Shivansh Sharma (technology and development), Shubham Kumar (business strategy and client solutions)

## Services

- **Professional Website Development**: bespoke, high-performance marketing sites built for conversion, with custom UI/UX, e-commerce and portals, SEO and speed optimisation, and mobile-first responsive layouts.
- **Custom Software Development**: tailored internal operations tools and CRM systems.
- **Problem-Solving Software**: bespoke systems that replace manual, chaotic processes with streamlined operations.
- **Business Dashboards & Analytics**: real-time operational reporting and insight dashboards.
- **App Development**: iOS, Android and web applications.
- **Restaurant POS & Management**: order, kitchen and billing ecosystems for food-service businesses.
- **AI Automation & Chatbots**: 24/7 intelligent customer agents and workflow automation.
- **Digital Marketing & Growth**: strategic brand positioning and growth marketing.
- **Paid Advertising & Performance**: targeted customer acquisition campaigns.
- **Social Media Management**: consistent, engaging social presence.
- **B2B Digital Infrastructure**: web, software, POS, AI automation and paid ads combined into one integrated growth ecosystem.
